title: Single-Stage Weakly Supervised Segmentation with Localization Token and Memory Bank

nodes.label: Input Image
nodes.semantic_desc: An RGB training image used for weakly supervised semantic segmentation.
nodes.visual_desc: A generic natural scene photo (e.g., street/indoor) without any overlaid text or annotations.

nodes.label: Image-level Labels
nodes.semantic_desc: Multi-class image-level supervision indicating which semantic categories appear in the image (no pixel masks).
nodes.visual_desc: A tag/list panel with small class icons (e.g., car, person, road) shown as symbols, not text.

nodes.label: Patch Tokenizer
nodes.semantic_desc: Splits the image into smaller patches/tokens (smaller patch size to improve localization granularity).
nodes.visual_desc: A module box labeled 'Patch Tokenizer' with an inset grid icon representing fine patches.

nodes.label: Localization Token
nodes.semantic_desc: A dedicated token injected at the input stage to encourage localization-aware representation learning under weak supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A small token vector icon (circle with 'L' symbol) feeding into the backbone alongside patch tokens.

nodes.label: SegFormer Backbone
nodes.semantic_desc: Transformer encoder backbone (SegFormer) extracting multi-scale feature maps from tokens.
nodes.visual_desc: A large rounded rectangle labeled 'SegFormer Backbone' with stacked feature pyramid glyphs inside.

nodes.label: Adapter Module
nodes.semantic_desc: Lightweight adaptation layer to improve pixel-level learning capacity without changing the main backbone heavily.
nodes.visual_desc: A slim plug-in block attached to the backbone output labeled 'Adapter'.

nodes.label: Classification Head
nodes.semantic_desc: Image-level classifier operating on global features to match image-level labels (weak supervision).
nodes.visual_desc: A small module box labeled 'Cls Head' outputting a bar-chart probability vector icon.

nodes.label: Classification Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Supervises image-level predictions using image-level labels (e.g., multi-label BCE / CE).
nodes.visual_desc: A diamond-shaped loss node labeled 'L_cls' with a small sigma icon.

nodes.label: Segmentation Decoder
nodes.semantic_desc: Decoder transforming backbone feature maps into dense per-pixel segmentation logits.
nodes.visual_desc: A module box labeled 'Decoder' with an upsampling arrow icon.

nodes.label: Predicted Segmentation
nodes.semantic_desc: Model predicted per-pixel semantic map (softmax probabilities or hard labels).
nodes.visual_desc: A color-coded segmentation mask overlay on the input image with multiple class colors.

nodes.label: Patch Clustering
nodes.semantic_desc: Clusters fine-grained patch features to form region/group prototypes supporting pseudo-label generation and pixel-level learning.
nodes.visual_desc: A clustering diagram icon (points grouped into colored clusters) inside a labeled module box.

nodes.label: Memory Bank
nodes.semantic_desc: Stores and updates feature prototypes/embeddings across iterations to stabilize clustering and pseudo-label quality.
nodes.visual_desc: A database cylinder icon labeled 'Memory Bank' with arrows indicating enqueue/dequeue.

nodes.label: Pseudo-label Generator
nodes.semantic_desc: Generates pseudo pixel-level labels from predictions and/or clustered features guided by image-level labels.
nodes.visual_desc: A module box labeled 'Pseudo-label Gen' outputting a mask icon with dashed boundaries.

nodes.label: Pseudo Labels
nodes.semantic_desc: Auto-generated pixel-level supervision masks used to train the segmentation branch.
nodes.visual_desc: A noisy segmentation mask (speckled/partial regions) shown as a dashed-outline colored mask.

nodes.label: Segmentation CE Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Cross-entropy loss between predicted segmentation and pseudo labels to provide dense supervision.
nodes.visual_desc: A diamond-shaped loss node labeled 'L_seg (CE)' with a pixel-grid icon.
